# 08 SOPS with helm-secrets under Helm 4.3.0, 2026-10-08, minikube helm4dev
# Tools: sops 3.13.3, age 1.3.2 (installed by scripts/install-tools.sh, sha256-verified, into .tools/bin), helm-secrets 4.7.9
# Key: throwaway age key generated by the demo under examples/08-config-secrets/.work/ (gitignored). No private key is committed.

## Install findings (manual, before the demo run)
- `helm plugin install https://github.com/jkroepke/helm-secrets --version v4.7.9 --verify=false` (git source) installs ONE plugin named secrets, type getter/v1, APIVERSION legacy. The `secrets://` getter works; `helm secrets ...` fails: Error: unknown command "secrets" for "helm".
- helm-secrets 4.x ships three Helm 4 plugins: secrets (cli/v1), secrets-getter (getter/v1), secrets-post-renderer (postrenderer/v1) (docs/Installation.md in the repository).
- `helm plugin install https://github.com/jkroepke/helm-secrets/releases/download/v4.7.9/secrets-4.7.9.tgz` with default verification: Error: plugin verification failed: reading keybox .../.tools/gnupg/pubring.kbx: keybox contains no OpenPGP keys. The release publishes .prov files; the maintainer's public key is not in the project GNUPGHOME, so the demo uses --verify=false.
- The same tgz-URL install ignored HELM_PLUGINS set to a separate directory and wrote the plugin into the shared .tools/helm/plugins. `oci://ghcr.io/jkroepke/helm-secrets/<plugin>:4.7.9` honored HELM_PLUGINS, but left secrets-4.7.9.tgz and .prov download leftovers in .tools/helm/plugins; the demo deletes them. The strays from the tgz attempts were removed by hand.

## Cluster cross-check after the run
$ kubectl -n hfd-08 get secret shipping-shipping-service -o jsonpath={.data.api-token} | base64 -d
sops-dev-token
$ helm plugin list (shared plugin dir, unchanged)
NAME    	VERSION	TYPE  	APIVERSION	PROVENANCE	SOURCE 
diff    	3.15.15	cli/v1	legacy    	unknown   	unknown
unittest	1.2.1  	cli/v1	legacy    	unknown   	unknown
$ ls .tools/helm/plugins
helm-diff
helm-unittest
$ grep -rl AGE-SECRET-KEY outside .work and .tools
(none)

## Idempotence
Two further ./demo.sh sops runs with the plugins and key already present exited 0 (plugin install skipped; the first of them exposed age-keygen refusing to overwrite wrong.agekey, fixed with rm -f). ./demo.sh clean removes .work/ and the release; ./demo.sh offline passes.
